home.title: Your Ethereum wallet, in one place
home.connectPrompt: Connect a wallet to sign in and see the ERC-721 tokens it holds.
home.signInPrompt: Sign in first — a wallet belongs to an account, and links to it in one click.

nft.title: Your collection
nft.empty: No tokens from this collection in your wallet yet.

pass.title: Claim your pass
pass.subtitle: A free, one-per-wallet NFT. The artwork is generated inside the contract from your address — no IPFS, nothing to go missing.

tip.title: Buy me a coffee, on chain
tip.subtitle: Tips run through a contract on {{chain}}, so every one of them is public and every message is stored in the event log. Testnet ETH — no real money changes hands.
tip.connectFirst: Connect a wallet to send a tip.
tip.empty: No tips yet. Be the first.
tip.signInFirst: Sign in and connect a wallet to send a tip.
tip.leaderboardEmpty: No supporters yet — the first name on the board could be yours.

landing.title: Your wallet, your art, your name on the board.
landing.subtitle: A full-stack Ethereum app: sign in, claim a generative NFT whose artwork lives inside the contract, and tip on chain. Everything below is read straight from Sepolia — no wallet needed to look.
landing.showcaseHint: Every image is generated inside the contract from the minter’s address. No IPFS, no server — the chain holds the art itself.
landing.showcaseEmpty: Nobody has claimed a pass yet. Be the first.

art.title: Art that cannot rot
art.body: tokenURI returns a data: URI built in Solidity — a symmetric identicon derived from keccak256 of your address. Nothing to pin, nothing to host, nothing to lose.

siwe.title: Sign-In with Ethereum
siwe.body: Linking a wallet is proved with EIP-4361: a single-use nonce, signed and burnt. A captured signature is worthless the second time it is used.

tx.title: Transactions as a state machine
tx.body: Gas is estimated before the wallet ever opens, so you can still walk away. Then signing, broadcast with the hash, and confirmation — each stage visible.

indexer.title: Its own chain indexer
indexer.body: Public RPC nodes refuse historical logs. A BullMQ worker follows the head in windows they do allow and keeps the history in Postgres, so the feeds cost a SELECT.

collect.title: Artifacts
collect.subtitle: Buy as many as you like. You choose the tier and pay for it — no lottery, no loot box. The artwork is generated in the contract, and the supply cap is enforced there too.
collect.hint: A higher tier draws more rings, more colour, and Legendary ones spin.
collect.connectFirst: Connect a wallet to buy an artifact.
collect.signInFirst: Sign in and connect a wallet to buy an artifact.

rating.title: Rating
rating.subtitle: Two boards, both folded out of the chain’s own event log — so anyone can recompute either one and get the same numbers.
rating.emptyDonors: No donations yet — the first name on the board could be yours.
rating.emptyCollectors: Nobody has minted anything yet. Be the first.
